name: optimal-challenge
description: Choose direct work or a cost-aware agent team while preserving user control and budget truthfulness.

interface.shortDescription: Choose the right workflow or agent team.
interface.longDescription: Handles simple work directly, forms cost-aware agent teams only when useful, asks only material questions, preserves continuity, and never presents an advisory budget as automatic enforcement.
interface.defaultPrompt: Assess this request, reuse verified state, and choose direct work or the smallest useful agent team without claiming automatic budget enforcement.
